2ef8594a-3552-487a-ad4f-fc8f2a03cffc.content:
fix: GrepHandler.searchStdin() now supports -A/-B/-C context line options

Root cause: searchStdin() ignored contextBefore/contextAfter/contextBoth options,
only outputting matching lines without surrounding context. This caused
`cat file | grep -A N pattern` to lose context lines in the pipeline.

Changes:
- Rewrote searchStdin() with two-pass algorithm: find matches, then collect context
- Fixed contextBoth default from 1 to 0 (matching native grep behavior)
- Added grep-style "--" separators between non-contiguous context groups
- Added grep-style line number separators (":" for match, "-" for context)
- Added 8 new test cases covering -A, -B, -C, edge cases, and separators

codeBindings.commitMessage:
[intent:I3.1.1.1] feat: add full-file exact substring match fallback in MultiSearchReplaceDiffStrategy

When buffer-range fuzzySearch fails (startLine significantly off), a new
exactSubstringSearch fallback scans the entire file using normalized
line-by-line comparison. Multiple matches are resolved by proximity to
startLine. This prevents false negatives when AI provides inaccurate
line numbers but the search content uniquely exists in the file.

ee443e33-9784-4cd9-85e8-7fda0ebb5745.assumption: 这是 A3.1.1 的第一个原子实现：在 multi-search-replace.ts 的 fuzzySearch 失败后（约第 407 行）、aggressive stripping 之前，插入全文精确子串搜索逻辑。这是核心修改。

4b144bbd-fc91-4a2d-a4b7-685ddef29415.content: 将 aggressive line stripping fallback 的 fuzzySearch 搜索范围从 buffer 范围扩大到 0/resultLines.length（全文范围），已在 I3.1.1.1 中一并实现
4b144bbd-fc91-4a2d-a4b7-685ddef29415.assumption: 这是 A3.1.1 的第二个原子实现：当前 aggressive stripping fallback 复用了 searchStartIndex/searchEndIndex（即 startLine ± 40行），走到这一步说明 buffer 范围内确实找不到，继续限制范围没有意义，应扩大到全文。
